newsitem.title: USA: Dragon acquisition to put '97 sales past $5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Dragon acquisition to put '97 sales past $5 mln.

text.p: Dragon Environmental Corp said Friday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire a Florida-based residuals management contractor, a company which hauls and disposes sludge from wastewater plants.
Dragon said it expects its 1997 gross sales to exceed $5 million with the addition of the new company.
The company said it expects a final contract to be completed within 30 days, and closing in May or June.

Dragon said it has been aggressively seeking acquisitions within related industries which service water and wastewater treatment facilities and that such acquisitions will be funded as a part of the investment banking relationship it began with Global Financial Group.
